description: Hypothesis: byte-preserving packed FP8 expert weights improve prefill versus the staged8 DeltaNet base (1885.2 tok/s) by coalescing four-byte weight loads. Enable --packed-experts --tuned-prefill --delta-mode staged8 with the same official FP8 target, DFlash2, FP16 KV, FP32 gate scratch/down output/accumulation/state, 2048-token chunks and explicit 32768-token context. Reorder weights once in private mapped memory at load time, retain original BF16 scales and checkpoint files, and reuse scales over each 128-wide K block. Predecoded FP16 weights, FP16 epilogues, tiny-row fallback and indirect dispatch were measured but are not enabled. Run all seven official Full-profile tests and inherit existing goals.
